scenes.label: KYOTO SPOT GUIDE
scenes.head: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove: get there before 8

scenes.label: 01  WHEN TO GO
scenes.head: Quiet: 7 to 8 a.m.
scenes.body: Busy from about 8 a.m., when the path turns into a slow line.

scenes.label: 02  OPEN
scenes.head: Always open, and free
scenes.body: No gate, no ticket. Whoever arrives early wins.

scenes.label: 03  TIP
scenes.head: Take your photos while it is quiet
scenes.body: At busy times, stopping on the narrow path blocks everyone behind you.

scenes.label: SAVE THIS
scenes.head: Send it to your Kyoto travel buddy.
